Access to DCS-3000 surveillance returns and subject PII

summary: Suspected Chinese state-linked hackers breached the FBI's DCS-3000 ('Red Hook') system, an unclassified component of the DCSNet surveillance network that stores pen register and trap-and-trace returns and PII of investigation subjects, by leveraging a commercial internet service provider's vendor infrastructure. The FBI detected suspicious activity on February 17, 2026 (at its Virgin Islands offices, per reports), told Congress, and later declared it a major cyber incident; investigators reportedly focused on Salt Typhoon.
